rows.name: first-intersection
rows.text: Genesis-to-intersection declarations become eligible when it reaches the marker. Decided; genesis construction remains open.
rows.title: First intersection

rows.name: declare-then-intersect
rows.text: Declarations before or on that intersection enter its window; declaration alone does not activate a key. Decided.
rows.title: Declare, then intersect

rows.name: change-keys
rows.text: A new counted intersection closes a new window; keys absent from it cease to authorize the following epoch. Decided; the latest consecutive window supplies the set, not a union of windows.
rows.title: Change keys

rows.name: window-with-no-declaration
rows.text: No key authorizes an act until a new counted intersection with declarations. Decided.
rows.title: Window with no declaration

rows.name: declarations-after-latest-counted-intersection
rows.text: No effect on this epoch's authority. Decided.
rows.title: Declarations after latest counted intersection

rows.name: later-intersection-merged-earlier-missing
rows.text: Later does not count; latest fully reached initial segment determines keys. Decided.
rows.title: Later intersection merged, earlier missing

rows.name: burn-before-any-counted-intersection
rows.text: It can wait; when a reached intersection exists, the burn is recognized if its own lineage also reaches the marker. Decided predicates; reached does not mean counted.
rows.title: Burn before any counted intersection

rows.name: third-party-burns-for-actor
rows.text: Attribution follows the output identifier, not the funder's identity; no signature delegation follows from paying. Decided, with token qualification required.
rows.title: Third party burns for Actor

rows.name: several-burns-in-one-transaction
rows.text: Each output is a separate destruction; none duplicates another by sharing a transaction. Decided; ordinary validity and representation admission remain.
rows.title: Several burns in one transaction

rows.name: burn-in-marker-transaction
rows.text: Reflexive reach includes it, provided the Actor-intersection predicate holds. Reflexive interpretation applies at the first marker too; transaction construction remains design work.
rows.title: Burn in marker transaction

rows.name: old-key-valid-last-epoch-absent-now
rows.text: Oracle does not authorize it now; a cryptographically valid signature alone is not local admission. Decided.
rows.title: Old key valid last epoch, absent now

rows.name: newly-declared-key-not-counted
rows.text: Same refusal of authority, without deleting the declaration or changing older acts. Decided.
rows.title: Newly declared key not counted

rows.name: no-new-counted-intersection-at-next-marker
rows.text: Same latest consecutive window, hence the same key set. Decided persistence.
rows.title: No new counted intersection at next marker

rows.name: third-parties-grow-ancestry
rows.text: Reading and retry costs grow; no partial walk may be labelled complete. Decided permission plus evidence consequence.
rows.title: Third parties grow ancestry

rows.name: token-lost
rows.text: The latest counted key set persists without a new token move; loss of token control alone does not revoke those keys. Decided persistence; no recovery promise and unsupported spends still end the supported path.
rows.title: Token lost

rows.name: token-under-another-s-control
rows.text: That control can authorize later declarations/intersections, not reassign prior burn or alter earlier recorded acts. Concept consequence of permanent identity and windows.
rows.title: Token under another's control

rows.name: chain-reorganization
rows.text: Re-evaluate applicable oracle evidence; old closure results remain calculations over old inputs. Paper oracle rule; deployment finality response remains separately owned.
rows.title: Chain reorganization

rows.name: first-marker
rows.text: No predecessor movement or accepted epoch exists; empty acceptance gives a zero baseline even when reached burns are recognized and supply the following epoch's gross amounts. Construction and comparison of actual first-seam inputs remain design work.
rows.title: First marker

rows.name: burn-existing-before-the-first-marker
rows.text: Recognized there when its burn and Actor-intersection lineage outputs are reached; included in the epoch after that marker against a zero entering state, without a temporal exclusion or a contribution to the initial empty effective projection.
rows.title: Burn existing before the first marker

rows.name: several-burns-or-a-burn-at-a-merge
rows.text: One deposit belongs to the resulting lineage output, not each burn; no payout is owed. Decided deposit convention.
rows.title: Several burns or a burn at a merge

rows.name: off-lineage-marker-movement
rows.text: Stop epoch chain, publish no automatic continuation; manual intervention not specified. Decided halt; intervention not said.
rows.title: Off-lineage marker movement

rows.name: source-or-merge-with-no-burn
rows.text: Zero burn contribution, while its ancestry and token intersections still matter. Concept consequence.
rows.title: Source or merge with no burn

rows.name: missing-token-path-or-missing-merge-input
rows.text: Valid partial paths retain their membership evidence and recognized burns supply a lower bound; an excess over the committed amount is a discrepancy, while exact totals and authority remain unavailable. Paper evidence distinction and proposed incomplete rule.
rows.title: Missing token path or missing merge input
